r1-0.notes: Card floating above a raised finger, fanned deck in the left hand with the launcher on the left wrist; braid over her left shoulder with red cord bow. Background plain brick buildings and hedges, no roses/terrace.

r1-1.notes: Card offered toward the viewer above an open left hand, launcher with red light on the left wrist, gothic building, lamp, roses, balustrade. Skirt just above the knee with tights; other hand hidden.

r1-2.notes: Two pale pink rose cards: one held up by her face, one pushed toward the camera by her left hand with the red-lit launcher on that wrist (pointed up, not at the viewer). Braid over her left shoulder with red cord bow, red rose ornament with tassel cords, gold rose brooch, crimson tie, blazer with crimson piping, long black coat with crimson lining, long plaid skirt and tights. Background: gothic manor with arched windows and a spire, rose bushes, balustrade terrace in golden late afternoon. Card faces carry only a rose.
